basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student majoring in psychology, currently residing in the Pacific Northwest. My interests include gaming, particularly the works of CoryxKenshin, and exploring virtual worlds. I enjoy discussing personality types and astrology, reflected in my browsing habits. I dislike confrontation but find myself drawn to communities supporting those with difficult family dynamics. I'm typically online during late evenings after school and work, as I'm juggling a part-time job as a barista. Single and focusing on personal growth, I value connections with like-minded individuals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily revolves around psychology and self-help, cultivated through my studies and personal experiences dealing with a challenging family environment. I've developed a strong understanding of mental health topics and the impact of familial relationships on personal well-being.
